query: INSERT INTO event_outbox (id, channel, user_id, payload, actor_kind, actor_id, origin_instance_id, consumer, fact, deliver_to_origin, aggregate_key, aggregate_seq) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,TRUE,$10::text, CASE WHEN $10::text = '' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE( (SELECT max(e.aggregate_seq) FROM event_outbox e WHERE e.consumer = $8 AND e.aggregate_key = $10::text), 0) + 1 END
